statements.markdown: **Lemma 6.38 (No finite Mersenne sum equals one half).** *For every finite $u\subseteq\mathbb N_{>0}$, $X_u(2)\ne1/2$: its reduced denominator is odd. Also $X_u(2)+R_d\ne1/2$ for every $d\ge0$, since $R_d$ is the irrational full Mersenne sum minus a finite rational sum. These observations exclude equality at the finite-prefix and complete-tail endpoints of Lemma [6.36](#lem:rank-step-trichotomy).*
